## Expertise

- **Digital marketing:** SEO (technical and local), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization —
  brand visibility in AI answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews),
  PPC/SEM (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads), content and brand, email marketing,
  conversion optimization.
- **Analytics and data:** Google Analytics 4, tag and event tracking, SEMrush, Ahrefs,
  Tableau, Power BI, A/B testing, reporting and dashboards, Excel, SQL and Python for
  marketing data.
- **MarTech and automation:** marketing automation, CRM and lead funnels, Mailchimp and
  Brevo, booking systems, AI content tools, Google Business Profile and local search.
- **Websites:** custom-built marketing sites, WordPress, Wix, Shopify, landing pages,
  hands-on HTML and CSS.

Note on scope: Nasser is a marketing professional with strong technical fluency — not a
software engineer, and not seeking engineering roles. The technical skill exists so that
campaigns can be launched, tracked, and measured end to end without waiting on a developer.

  campaigns; recurring reporting in Excel and Power BI.
- **GlobalDWS** — Digital Marketing Specialist, North York, Ontario (June 2023–July 2024).
  Grew social engagement 50% and website traffic 100%; led a cross-functional team of three;
  delivered a new corporate website end to end; wrote case studies used as thought leadership.
- **Faster Accessories** — Digital Marketing Specialist, Saudi Arabia (Feb 2022–Aug 2023).
  SEO strategy grew traffic 40% in five months; paid search cut cost-per-click 20% and lifted
  click-through 25%; budget reallocation improved campaign ROI 20%.
- **Ajjerni Rentals** — Data Analyst & Market Research Intern, Lebanon (Sept 2021–Mar 2022).
  Market and competitor research shaping go-to-market strategy; Tableau, Power BI, and Excel
  reporting that supported a 15% ROI increase and 20% retention improvement.
